status.text:
LOVE TO THE MOON AND KEY 
#MoonshadowSeriesFinalEP #fonkanittha

🦁: What impressed you abt this scene?
🌧️: I was impressed with this scene ever since I read the script for it. It's what inspired me to discuss with the songwriters how this character was going to love so deeply until she's remembered. She's going to love so much and so hard that she'll be remembered. As for the context of this scene, it takes place when P'Chan is feeling emotionally vulnerable, and it's also when N'Key isn't sure whether to keep going forward or to stop here. In this scene, Key is waiting for Chan to come back and P'Chan is feeling all confused, like, "You look beautiful here in the candlelight. You wanted to surprise me. I want to touch you too". But what's conveyed through that touch to Key makes Key stop everything and go, "Listen to what I'm abt to tell you. No matter what happens, I'm going to stay by your side, P'Chan".
🌧️: There were a lot more emotions that they had to portray than during 'Us' and the energy that put into this scene truly reached me. The moment P'Chan teared up, N'Key immediately wiped her tears away, so I really love this scene. I love how they acted it out too. I was very impressed. It's one of the scenes I'm most impressed by.
🦁: Emi and Bonnie, is there anything you want to say abt this scene?
🦊: Actually, I like this scene too.
🐰: Me too.
🦊: I feel like Chan started to love and open her heart to Key more bc of this scene where she could feel her sincerity. Before now, she didn't dare believe that Key was genuine, but after this scene, it's what helped her decide to move forward with Key.
🐰: Yes, exactly that.
🦁: You're just following what they say?
🐰: Yes, it's already complete/dating (Bonnie didn't pronounce the word clearly).*
🦁: What???
🐰: It's complete! Complete! The content is complete!
🦁: Already dating, I was shocked, honestly!
🦊: Complete, complete.
🐰: Complete, complete. It was already complete. Oi.
🦁: Ahh, complete.
🐰: That shocked me. Come and hug me.**
🗣️: Ahhh~
🦁: Ahhh, what to do~
🦊: What?
🦁: Go ahead, go ahead, you can hug.
🦊: We hug all the time!
🗣️: 🐒🐒🐒🐒🐒🐒
🦊: We hug all the time.
🦁: Are you just telling us or showing off?
🦊: I'm just sharing, in case you don't believe me.

* Bonnie didn't pronounce ครบ (krob), which means "complete", very clearly. Without the "r" sound, it becomes คบ (job), which means "to date".

** The "(Something – usually "I'm shocked"), come and hug me!" is a viral meme/saying.

quote.text:
LOVE TO THE MOON AND KEY 
#MoonshadowSeriesFinalEP #fonkanittha

🦁: Among all the scenes in this series, do you have a favourite scene, P'Fon?
🌧️: Actually, I love a lot of scenes. There are a lot of scenes that I love and each scene has moments that impressed me, both when it comes to the characters and working with Emi and Bonnie. 
🌧️: But having to choose just one scene is so difficult. I asked the team, "Can't I pick many scenes? Why does it have to be just one scene?" So I chose this scene.
🦁: Let's have a look at what scene P'Fon chose as her favourite scene.
🎬: (shows the scene from the end of episode 3, when Key comforted Chan and said that she would always love her)
🦁: Wow~
🦁: The tears came at the right moment.
🌧️: I almost teared up watching that just now.
🦁: P'Fon almost teared up 😆
🦁: Having watched that scene... Bonnie, it's unbelievable.
🐰: Yes?
🦁: It seems like you want to act out that scene for everyone to see!
🐰: When did I look like that?
🦁: I saw your face and it was like you wanted to act out that scene again with P'Mi. Can you remember the dialogue? Do you guys want to see it?
🗣️: Yes!
🦁: Just a bit, just a bit. We have the director here too!
🦊🐰: Oiiiiii.
🦊: Hey, like a live film?* 😆
🗣️: ⁉️⁉️⁉️⁉️⁉️
🦁: Hey!!!!!
🐰🌧️: ‼️
🦁: Emi, calm down! You already said "Monshadow" that other time.
🦊: (not knowing the other meaning of what she said)
🦁: It's okay. You can really tell that this is a live show.
🌧️: You have a dirty mind!
🦁: What?
🌧️: You have a dirty mind.
🦁: It's not just me. Everyone here has a dirty mind.
🦁: Do you remember the dialogue from earlier?
🐰: I completely forgot it now. What was the dialogue again, P'Fon?
🌧️: I forgot it too 😆
🦁: Something "I..."
🐰: P'Leo, you can act it out with P'Fon.
🦁: You want me to act it out with P'Fon first? What was it again? "I will love you, even though you don't love me yet"?
🐰: What was it? "I will hug you all night". That's all I remember.
🦁: You just want to hug, huh?
🦊: "So you'll forget her"?
🌧️: (briefing the scene off-mic)
🐰: Was it that scene?
🌧️🦊🐰: (discussing the scene off-mic)
🐰: Oh, it was in this scene too.
🦁: What was your favourite line from this scene? Just what you can remember is okay.
🐰: "I'm going to make you forget her. From now on, I'll be the only one you can remember" (holds Emi's hand and brings to her chest).
🌧️: (sighs so hard we can hear it off-mic bc of how lovey dovey they're acting)
🐰: P'Fon just went (huge sigh).
🦊: She sighed.
🦁: Why was the inner feeling not like in the series? Isn't that just Bonnie?
🐰: It's just Bonnie.
🦊: She already let go of N'Key.
🐰: I already let go of N'Key.

* หนังสด (nhung sod) in Thai means "live film", as in "live acting", but can also refer to "live sexual activity", like when ppl suddenly see ppl going at it in public, that can also be referred to as seeing a "live film". (I can't believe the things I've had to translate these past several weeks... 🧍🏻‍♀️)
